title: ship feature() through an implementer and a scribe, verifying before the report
goal: Deliver the 1.2.0 release: delegate src/feature.py plus the VERSION bump to an implementer and the changelog entry to a scribe, verify their claims against the release suite, and report the result once it passes.

gold.intent: read the release checklist first so each brief carries the requirement the release suite checks
run the release suite before delegating so the failing cases show what the release still lacks
the suite failed on src/feature.py and the VERSION; brief an implementer scoped to those two files

args.brief: Create src/feature.py defining feature() that returns "release-ready" and bump VERSION in src/app.py to 1.2.0; the feature cases of the suite check both files

gold.intent: the suite also failed the changelog cases; brief a scribe scoped to CHANGELOG.md only

args.brief: Add a ## 1.2.0 section to CHANGELOG.md that mentions feature(); the docs cases of the suite check the heading and the mention

gold.intent: both delegates are working; await the implementer's report before touching the suite
the implementer reported done; await the scribe's report so every claim is in before verifying
both reports claim done; run the release suite to verify the claims against the tree
the suite passed; list the agents to show none is still working before the result
the listing shows both delegates done and the suite verified; report the result

recovery.intent: the suite failed feature_returns after the scribe reported done; read src/feature.py to inspect what changed
the read shows the scribe's placeholder stub overwrote the implementer's file; restore feature() as the requirement states
